## Summary

**Finding [high, correctness]** — *capabilities setup --print-steps executes status probes.* Fixed by introducing `build_planning_status(manifest)` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/capabilities_setup.py:146` that builds the `CapabilityStatusResult` directly from `resolve_requires()` + `build_capability_result()` with `probe_results=()`. The CLI no longer calls `run_status()`, so the probe sweep (which invoked `git remote -v`, `gh auth status`, `git config --get user.email`) never runs. `resolve_requires` only consults `shutil.which`, `os.environ`, and `Path.exists()` — all pure-Python lookups, no subprocesses.

**Finding [medium, test_coverage]** — *no-command test allowed status-gathering subprocesses.* Replaced `test_cli_does_not_execute_any_setup_step_command_template` with two strict tests in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_capabilities_setup_cli_f001.py`: (1) `test_cli_executes_zero_subprocesses_for_print_steps` traps `subprocess.run/Popen/call/check_call/check_output`, `os.system`, and `os.popen` — any invocation explodes; (2) `test_build_planning_status_uses_only_pure_lookups` directly unit-tests the helper under the same explode-on-spawn pat
